title: shd-ccp update_geo (JSON form)
description: Human-readable/JSON form of the shd-ccp geometric instruction. The orchestrator API accepts this form. On the mesh it is encoded into the 52-byte binary wire form (protocols/docs/shd-ccp_wire_format.md). Field names match the original Biopuck spec; later additions are optional.

node.description: Target node id, or '*' for broadcast

fc.description: Carrier frequency (Hz); for coil nodes, PWM base frequency

pos.description: Spatial coordinate (metres, user-centred: +x right, +y forward, +z up)
